A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''high prefect''' of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]]'s [[intendant caste]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] the [[Praetorite Vong]], a spearhead force established ahead of its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GoI" /> Most of the Praetorite Vong's forces were destroyed in the<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> [[Battle of Helska IV]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> where the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] attacked and destroyed the force's [[Helska IV base|base]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Helska IV]].<ref name="VP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The high prefect was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The sourcebook identifies the high prefect as the Praetorite Vong's leader; however, it also identifies [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]] as the force's leader.<ref name="GoI" /> This article assumes that the high prefect was the Praetorite Vong's leader.
